title: Won’t reset for next day
body: The app won’t reset for the next day. I’ve written and not yet an answer. Not sure if there is a problem with international time.
author: R1assie

title: Your own way of tracking your habits
body:
I really like this app. You get to create your own detailed views of what you want to track, but you also get an easy overview of all habits. Lots of flexibility and customisation. 

It doesn’t get five stars for a couple of reasons:

- I expected way more options for photos, especially since it’s such a visual design and other apps let you chose from huge libraries. The selection here is extremely disappointing, even with the premium version. This would be a five star if not for this - it wastes the potential of an otherwise gorgeous design.
- no home screen widget
- I wish there was a card that just let you add some text, e.g. a quote, a reminder of why you’re doing this, info you need to do it (like what to do in your bedtime yoga routine)

title: Great tracker
body: Really love this tracker and great to see streaks. Really helps keep me motivated. One question to the devs - what is the “skip” function used for? If you use it when you don’t do a habit, it looks like it impacts streak stats. So when is it to be used?
author: WeatherD

title: Great! But...
body: I love this app! It’s one of the most help apps I’ve ever used! The only problem is that I need to pay to get more that 3 habits. I love this app, but I don’t think that the app should have limitation for habits, rather it should have it for other features that don’t make a difference, like the background or anything like that. I would give it a 5 start rating, but that’s the only reason I give it a 3 star rating.

author: Pabp

title: Gorgeous
body:
I don't often feel compelled to write software reviews, but this is simply one of the most beautiful iPhone apps I've ever had the pleasure to use.

I always appreciate well crafted UI, but here it provides an especially important benefit: since the purpose of the app is to build habits, it really helps that the user experience is so visually elegant and intuitive. 

It changes habit tracking from a chore into a fun experience I enjoy and look forward to. Really helps me stay motivated. Great app.

title: so far so good
body:
enjoying the lay out and the simplicity of the over all UI
Kinda weird using 3D Touch without haptic feedback which surprisingly made the interaction with the app seem a little foreign based on the overall interaction with the iPhone 6S
it's a small thing but still it would benefit to have such a small and powerful extra to really make you feel interaction with the app

also seemed a little slow even on a iPhone 6S
but I'm sure performance updates are on the way

overall enjoying this app so far and already my third day in a row using it
